checks.must: Saves still send the JSON:API envelope from toJSON and read responses via parse (data.attributes), e.g. by keeping model.save; a plain fetch with a flat body fails unless explicitly flagged.

The #header .name still updates when displayName changes (change:displayName listener kept or replicated).
The 'saved' indicator after sync is preserved.
